lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly regular grid of high-luminance, circular white spots extending from the posterior branchial region across the lateral flank, transitioning from smaller, high-density clusters on the head to larger, spaced nodes on the torso.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, creating a grid-like configuration where the blobs serve as primary intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and deep shadows on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, horizontal reddish-orange linear marking is present on the mid-lateral flank, positioned between two vertical stripes in the central region of the body.
other_distinctive_markers: Several small commensal fish (remoras) are visible near the pectoral fin and along the ventral-posterior silhouette.
